alerts.headline: Gemini Notebook于9/23全量成为Google Docs的context source：在Docs中'@'引用已有Notebook即可将研究资料接入文档且自动插入行内引用，无需切换标签页或复制粘贴，是跨工具artifact引用机制在Google生态的又一产品化案例
alerts.evidence: 「The feature bridges the gap between deep research and content creation by grounding drafts in a curated knowledge base without the need to switch tabs or copy-paste between tools.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议下一轮核实'@引用Notebook'后文档内容是否随Notebook源数据更新而持续live同步，还是仅引用时刻的一次性snapshot pull；并结合上一轮Workspace Studio Custom Starters的方向，评估Google跨工具artifact机制对meee2锚点2、4差异化优势的累积收窄速度。
